paite: Na tuailai nite in nang hon siampa theigige in, ni hoihloute ahong tun ua kumte ahong nai ua, Amaute ah kipahna ka nei kei, na chih hun ahong tun nai louh lai in.
heading: Upat Hun Leh Sih Hun

paite: Ni hiam, khovak leh kha leh aksite, hihmial a om a, meipite vuahzuk khit a akik nawn ma un;
inn ngakte akivuan ua, mihatte ahong kun ua, atawm tak ziak ua ansute akhawl ua, tawlet a dakkhete hihmial a a-om ua,
kongzing akongkhakte khak ahih nai louh lai un; ansuk ging angaih louh a, vasa aw a mi athoh a, tumging theih tanute tengteng sukniam a a-om nai louh lai un;

Ahi, tungsang a om akihta ding ua, alampi ah launa a-om ding; vaisuaklu sing apaklun ding a, huan khaukhup tunggikna ahi dia, lingmin thuk azuau ding; mihing a-inn sau a pai a, suun mite kongzing kim a apai ziak un.
Dangka khau kiphel a, dangka-eng noubem suktap a a-om a, tuibel tuikhuk a hihkek a a-om a, tuibem a kangtalai khe hihtan a a-om nai louh lai in.
Huan a-om bang in leivui lei ah akik nawn a, kha bel apepa Pathian kiang ah akik hi.
Bangmah loute bangmah lou, thugenmi'n achi; bang teng bangmah lou ahi.
Huai ban ah, Thugenpa apil ziak in, mite theihna asinsak lailai a; ahi, paunak tampi kizomzom in angaihtuah a, azongkhia a, akoih hi.
heading: Thukhitna

paite: Thugenpa'n thu pomtakte mukhe ding in azong a; diktak a gelhkhiak a omte, thutak thute ngei.
Mipil thute sutna zum bang ahi a, hoihtak a khetkip sikkilhnate bang tuh Belamchingpa khat thugen lakkhawm piakte ahi.
Huan huai lou leng, ka tapa, hilh in om in; laibu tampi bawl ahihleh tawp chih ni a-om kei hi; huan zil tamna zaw taksa bahna ahi.
Hiai thu leh la tawpna ahi; avek in zak in a-omta; Pathian laudan siam inla, athupiakte zui in; hiai lah mihing hih ding pumpi ahi.
Pathian in thilhih chiteng, thil selguk chiteng, ahoih hia ahihkeileh ahoih lou toh vaihawmna a lalut ding ahi.
